concepts.def: Spain shifted from emigration country to net immigration country in the 1990s.
Undocumented migrants; mass regularisation in 2005 affected over 500,000 people.
Gibraltar Strait — historic crossing point for migrants from North Africa.
Small boats used by migrants crossing from Morocco or via the Canaries route.
Used after expressions of doubt, emotion, will: 'es necesario que, quiero que, aunque'.
Legal route to residency in Spain after three years of demonstrated social integration.
